parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables Dynamic DNS Server. Note: This parameter was previously wrongly defined as a string.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The textual name of the Dynamic DNS Server.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: Dynamic DNS service used to contact this server. {{reference}}

parameters.name: ServerAddress
parameters.description: Host name or IP address of the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: ServerPort
parameters.description: Port number of the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: SupportedProtocols
parameters.description: Indicates the protocols that are supported by the CPE for sending requests to the Dynamic DNS server. {{list}} This list depends on the Dynamic DNS service defined by the {{param|ServiceName}} parameter.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: Indicates the protocol used to send requests to the Dynamic DNS server.

parameters.name: CheckInterval
parameters.description: Interval (in {{units}}) between two checks for IP change. A value of zero indicates that the CPE knows when IP changes and doesn’t need to check it periodically.

parameters.name: RetryInterval
parameters.description: Initial retry interval (in {{units}}) after a failed request. This parameter can be used as a fixed value or as part of a retry interval calculation.

parameters.name: MaxRetries
parameters.description: Maximum number of retries after a failed request. When the maximum number is reached, no further requests are sent until the context changes. A value of 0 means that there are no retries after a failed request.

object.description: Table of Dynamic DNS servers available for this CPE.
